## Convert More Leads, Close More Deals

Seedtable's intelligence platform gives you the edge to identify, connect with, and convert high-intent prospects faster than your competition.

### Identify Hot Prospects

Filter through 1.7M companies to find those most likely to need your services based on funding stage, growth signals, and our proprietary 'Likely to Outsource' indicators.


### Access Decision-Makers

Skip the gatekeepers with direct contact information for 50K+ founders, C-suite executives, and department heads who make purchasing decisions.


### Perfect Your Timing

Leverage funding alerts, growth signals, and company milestones to reach out at exactly the right moment when companies are ready to buy.


### Segment & Export

Build targeted prospect lists with unlimited filtering options, then export the CSV or integrate directly with your CRM to start your campaigns immediately.


### Buying Intent Signals

Our regularly updated 'likely to outsource' tags identify companies actively seeking new vendors and solutions right now - so you can reach out at the perfect moment.


### Funding Alert System

Track recent investments across 15,000+ VC firms to identify companies with fresh capital to spend on new solutions, services, and partnerships.
